paper_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: What are the specific chemical components used in the design of the nonfullerene acceptor IPIC-4Cl?
qa_pairs.answer: IPIC-4Cl is designed using an indacenobis(dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol) (INP) fused-ring core. It incorporates branched 2-butyl-1-octyl (BO) side chains and chlorinated (dicyanomethylidene)-indan-1-one (IC) units as the electron-accepting end groups.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: How does chlorination of the end groups in IPIC-4Cl affect its optical bandgap compared to fluorinated and non-halogenated versions?
qa_pairs.answer: Chlorination in IPIC-4Cl results in a narrower optical bandgap of 1.32 eV. This is lower than the 1.38 eV bandgap of the fluorinated counterpart (IPIC-4F) and the 1.44 eV bandgap of the non-halogenated version (IPIC).
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: What are the photovoltaic performance metrics for the champion binary organic solar cell utilizing PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl?
qa_pairs.answer: The champion PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl binary device achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 13.4%. Its other performance metrics include a short-circuit current (JSC) of 22.2 mA cm⁻², an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 813 mV, and a fill factor (FF) of 74.0%.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: Based on DFT calculations, how does the dipole moment of the chlorinated IPIC-4Cl model compare to the fluorinated and hydrogenated models, and what is the physical implication?
qa_pairs.answer: The chlorinated model (h-4Cl) possesses a dipole moment of 11.82 D, which is larger than the fluorinated (11.04 D) and hydrogenated (8.47 D) models. This increase in dipole moment indicates an enhanced intramolecular charge transfer (ICT) effect in the chlorinated acceptor.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: What improvements are observed when 30 wt% PC71BM is added to the PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl blend, and what are the underlying reasons?
qa_pairs.answer: The addition of 30 wt% PC71BM increases the PCE to 14.3%. It achieves this by acting as a phase mediator and an electron-transporting channel, which together enhance carrier generation and improve the balance of charge transport.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: How does the molecular packing of IPIC-4Cl compare to other materials in the series according to GIWAXS data?
qa_pairs.answer: IPIC-4Cl neat films exhibit the strongest intermolecular aggregation in the series. This is evidenced by it having the smallest π-π stacking distance (dπ-π) of 3.45 Å.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: Compare the charge mobilities of the PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl blend with those of the IPIC-4F and IPIC blends.
qa_pairs.answer: PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl blend films exhibit higher and more balanced charge mobilities than IPIC-4F and IPIC blends. Specifically, it shows a hole mobility (μh) of 1.26 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹ and an electron mobility (μe) of 1.00 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, resulting in a balanced μh/μe ratio of 1.26.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring

qa_pairs.question: What does the VOC versus light intensity slope indicate about the recombination mechanisms in PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl devices?
qa_pairs.answer: The PBDB-T:IPIC-4Cl device has a slope of 1.16 kT/q, which is lower than that of IPIC-4F (1.21 kT/q) and IPIC (1.95 kT/q). This lower slope indicates that trap-assisted recombination is effectively suppressed in the IPIC-4Cl-based devices.
qa_pairs.source_title: Nonfullerene Acceptor for Organic Solar Cells with Chlorination on Dithieno[3,2-b:2',3'-d]pyrrol Fused-Ring
